scope: Diagnostic in-process healthy-composition sweep. Mechanisms are exercised, not individually certified. Selection covers declared single-axis values, mechanism IDs and assertions, not every interaction.

exclusions.reason: Concurrent bursts over real sockets have a timing-dependent oracle; bounded contention is covered over Loopback.

rules.reason: Ordinary nodes negotiate sessions, propagate all endpoint routes and send through the production data path. Fault, tie-break and rejection branches are not certified here.
The production process-local fabric carries every packet; it declares receiver-capacity pacing rather than per-hop credit.
WebSocket framing carries the packets and the controller enables receiver credit for a channel that can be outrun. This does not assert exhaustion or cross-process pacing.
The geometry factory constructs node-keyed pre-shared-key channels; security rejection cases remain in adapter tests.

assertions.claim: Every endpoint has a selected route at every node before traffic.
One payload reaches the named destination with the expected content.
Observed destination ordinals exactly match the offered ordered stream.
At least one send is admitted; all sends settle; observed arrivals equal admissions without duplicates, and refusals are QUEUE_FULL.
The destination still selects the source endpoint after traffic.
